body.label: Trigger
body.html: A creature you can see within 4 units begins an Action or Reaction.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Choose yourself or one ally within 4 units. That creature gains +1 Defense against the triggering effect, or may move 1 unit after it resolves.

surges.html: One creature benefiting from this Reaction gains +1 Movement until its next turn.
Choose one additional eligible creature within 1 unit to receive a non-damage benefit of this Reaction.
